meta.narrative: When Dionne is working on a project, she always consults with her supervisor, Evann. Evann always appreciates Dionne's attention to detail and thoroughness.

messages.content: Hey Aris, what's with the long face? You're so sensitive. I was just borrowing your lunch money, I'll pay you back... eventually. Don't be such a baby, it was just a joke!
Kaius, that wasn't a joke. You took my lunch money and didn't give it back. I need it to buy food. You always do this, and it's not funny. Just give me back my money, and leave me alone.

meta.head: PersonX causes PersonY some problems
meta.literal: Kaius is a troublemaker. Kaius causes Aris some problems.
meta.narrative: Kaius is a troublemaker. Kaius often teases Aris and makes him feel left out. Yesterday, Kaius took Aris' lunch money and didn't give it back.
